text:
incidents-bot: ALERT — sustained 5xx spike detected on /v1/generate (rate > 4% for 5m). Paging oncall.

jordan: got it. I'm oncall. seeing a flurry of 504/gateway_timeouts from provider upstream. digging into proxy logs now.

jordan: quick tail of the ingress error stream:
```
2026-03-01T12:34:01Z ERROR proxy request_id=abc123 status=504 upstream=cloud-eu-1 node=ingress-3 path=/v1/generate latency=12002ms
2026-03-01T12:34:03Z ERROR proxy request_id=def456 status=502 upstream=cloud-eu-2 node=ingress-1 path=/v1/generate latency=9056ms
```

anika: @jordan thx. do we know if this is regional? any correlation with provider maintenance windows?

jordan: looks concentrated to eu regions. provider status page shows a partial network flapping event in eu-west. linking: https://status.examplecloud/incident/1234

mike: if upstream is flaky, we should failover to cached smaller model or local-replica for low-latency routes. Can we flip routing for non-critical traffic?

jordan: doing temporary routing change: will add a policy to divert <10% of traffic to local-small model and enable aggressive prefix KV cache for repeat keys.

ops-bot: change request submitted: route-weight set for model-small: 10% in eu region. change-id=chg-778

sara: heads-up — CS already seeing elevated customer errors. pushing status update to impacted accounts. Any ETA on mitigation?

anika: mitigation steps in progress: 1) increase ingress proxy retries to 3 with jitter, 2) enable short-circuit fallback to model-small for requests with >1s backend latency, 3) suppress noisy alerting thresholds while we stabilize. Doing step 1 now.

jordan: adjusted proxy retry config on the cluster via k8s patch:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  proxy.retries: "3"
  proxy.retryBackoffMs: "200"
```

jordan: temporarily muted the paging rule for /v1/generate 5xx oncall page — still logging and dashboarding. Reason: upstream provider latency spike; we will track but avoid alert fatigue. mute-id=mute-221

anika: creating a focused dashboard panel showing 5xx by upstream provider & region, plus p95 latency buckets. will share link when ready.

mike: FYI increased pod replica count for proxy in eu cluster by +50% to absorb bursts. watch CPU/queue.

incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-20260301-95. Severity: P2. Lead: jordan. Links: runbook/gateway-upstream.md

jordan: quick customer-impact summary for ops channel: approx 2.3% of requests returned 5xx in last 10m, majority 504. Root cause appears to be intermittent network issues at cloud provider in eu-west. mitigation: retries + fallback routing + scale. no rollback planned for provider — they appear to be rolling fixes.

sara: noted — sending an interim status message to impacted customers: ETA unknown but we have mitigations in place.

anika: dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/incident/1954321000 — panels: 5xx rate by upstream, p95 latency, retries triggered, traffic split. added annotations for mute and route-weight change.

jordan: monitoring. p95 dropped from 9.8s to 1.2s after retries + fallback for a subset of traffic. 5xx rate down to 1.1% and trending down.

mike: can we avoid paging when provider has an open incident? suggestion: add an alert condition that suppresses page for provider-originated 502/504 if provider status=degraded AND overall user-impact < 5% for 10m.

anika: agreed. after-action action item: add suppression rule and tune thresholds. I'll open a PR to ops-alerts repo with proposed rule diffs.

jordan: oncall handoff in 30m — @anika can you take the follow-up and continue monitoring? I'll add notes in the incident thread and then hand off.

anika: can do. I'll own postmortem and alert tuning.

jordan: handover notes: what we changed - proxy retries, route-weight to model-small(10%), muted paging rule (mute-221), scaled proxy pods. Current state - 5xx ~0.8%, p95 ~1.05s, provider reports partial fix. Next steps - add suppression, create long-term dashboard, update runbook with provider-specific guidance.

anika: creating a checklist now and assigning owners:
- anika: PR for alert suppression + new alert for 5xx segmented by upstream (rule name: upstream_5xx_by_provider)
- mike: infra task to add automatic model fallback config to routing service (task INF-449)
- jordan: correlation logs export for postmortem (s3://redwood-incident-1954321000)
- sara: customer comms follow-up

sara: scheduling a brief customer update at +1h. will include current mitigation and recommended retries on client side.

incidents-bot: Reminder: Incident INC-20260301-95 has been updated. Status: stabilizing. Next update due in 45m.

anika: post-incident tuning notes (initial):
- raise the paging threshold for global 5xx alert from 1% to 3% for 5m windows for routes with provider-originated errors
- add a suppression filter that suppresses pages if upstream provider reports incident and overall user-impact < 5%
- create separate alerts: one for internal routing failures (always page) and one for provider 5xx (log only + slack notify)
- add synthetic healthchecks that exercise upstream provider endpoints from multiple regions every 1m
- add label to logs/metrics for upstream_provider, region, and e2e_path to help triage

mike: +1 on synthetics. I'll own the synthetic runner and add eu-west probes.

jordan: good notes. I'll drop a short postmortem draft tonight. tagging the runbook: runbook/gateway-upstream.md updated with fallback procedure.

anika: closing the oncall mute and gating the silence in 2h after provider status clears. we'll re-enable paging rules then.

sara: thanks everyone — I'll file the customer follow-ups and add a note to impacted accounts.

jordan: handing off: @anika — you're the oncall lead now. I'm available if anything re-escalates. :thumbsup:

anika: taking over. moving to follow-up channel for postmortem work.

ops-bot: deploy event: applied config chg-778 to route-weight; rollout complete.

incidents-bot: Incident INC-20260301-95 — transitioned to monitoring. Severity downgraded to P3.

anika: ACTIONS OUTSTANDING (summary):
- PR with alert suppression and new upstream_5xx_by_provider rule — due EOD (anika)
- infra task INF-449 for fallback routing automation — due 3/8 (mike)
- synthetic probes in eu-west — due 3/3 (mike)
- export logs + initial postmortem draft — due 3/2 (jordan)
- customer outreach follow-up — due immediate (sara)

sara: noted and executing.

jordan: thanks team, nice coordination. closing thread from my side once anika confirms monitoring stable.

anika: confirmed stable for now, will keep an eye. closing thread in #incidents after postmortem is posted.
